strings.zh: 今天是因为我{NEWLINE}状态不怎么好！{SCROLL}我下次还想找你对战,{NEWLINE}把你电话号码给我吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I wasn’t feeling my best today,{NEWLINE}that’s all!{SCROLL}We should trade phone numbers,{NEWLINE}then we can battle again! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 下次再见的时候,{NEWLINE}我会变得更强！
strings.en: The next time we meet, I’ll be much{NEWLINE}stronger, I promise!
You bastard! You’re gonna{NEWLINE}win and just run off?

strings.zh: 今天是因为我{NEWLINE}状态不怎么好！{SCROLL}我下次还想找你对战,{NEWLINE}把你电话号码给我吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I wasn’t feeling my best today,{NEWLINE}that’s all!{SCROLL}We should trade phone numbers,{NEWLINE}then we can battle again! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你是来拿暗之石的吗？{NEWLINE}就是这个⋯⋯{SCROLL}你别磨蹭了！{NEWLINE}拿了就快走吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: You here for the Dusk{NEWLINE}Stone? This is it...{SCROLL}Quit dawdling! Take it and scram!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}我有这么可怕吗？{SCROLL}我知道你现在{NEWLINE}就在自行车道上。{SCROLL}既然你就在附近,{NEWLINE}那直接找我聊天吧！
strings.en: Hey, now...{NEWLINE}Am I really that scary to you?{SCROLL}You know that I know you’re on{NEWLINE}Cycling Road, right?{SCROLL}If you’re going to come all the way out{NEWLINE}here, you might as well talk in person!

strings.zh: 哈哈哈！{NEWLINE}我的{VAR:0100:10}{CLEAR}有了非一般的进步！{SCROLL}就在前不久还秒杀了{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}我已经无敌了！{NEWLINE}对方闻风丧胆啊！
strings.en: Ha ha ha! My {VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}has gotten crazy strong!{SCROLL}Just the other day, it took{NEWLINE}out a {VAR:0100:11} in one hit!{SCROLL}I’m unstoppable now! Everyone shakes{NEWLINE}in their boots when they hear my name!

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}变得很强了,{CLEAR}不过我还是在最后{CLEAR}放跑了{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}逃掉？开什么玩笑！{NEWLINE}是我放他走的！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} has gotten much{NEWLINE}stronger, but we still let a wild{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:11} we were battling{CLEAR}run away!{SCROLL}What, you think it got away on us?{NEWLINE}No way, man! We LET it run away!

strings.zh: 前不久我在路旁{NEWLINE}偶然遇到了{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}由于它出现得很突然,{NEWLINE}我反被它给掀翻在地！{SCROLL}我有没有受伤？{SCROLL}还好有精灵帮我{NEWLINE}做弹簧垫才没事！
strings.en: Recently we found a wild {VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}by the roadside!{SCROLL}It showed up so suddenly that it{NEWLINE}knocked me flat on the ground!{SCROLL}Did I get hurt?{SCROLL}No--I landed on my Pokémon, and it{NEWLINE}cushioned my fall!

strings.zh: 哦哦哦⋯⋯{NEWLINE}我战斗的意志又燃烧了,{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}你快来打倒我吧！
strings.en: Ohhh... My fighting{NEWLINE}spirit’s burning again.{SCROLL}I’m at {VAR:0104:3}. Get{NEWLINE}over here and try to take me down!

strings.zh: 你在搞什么啊！{NEWLINE}我们不是约好了{CLEAR}要对战的吗！{SCROLL}我就在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}你别忘了！
strings.en: What’s the deal?! Didn’t we agree to{NEWLINE}battle?!{SCROLL}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}. Don’t you{NEWLINE}forget it!
strings.notes: US 0701/11 | RV073: addition: removed added 'get schooled'/'hurry up'; 你别忘了 = don't forget

strings.zh: 有些人说{NEWLINE}正是因为自行车道{CLEAR}有我们这些暴走族在,{SCROLL}所以这里的风气才变坏了。{SCROLL}我们平时才不会给{NEWLINE}那些人捣乱呢！{SCROLL}只有遇到厉害的训练师时{NEWLINE}我们才会去挑衅的,{SCROLL}比如就像你这样的！
strings.en: After my Biker gang showed up on{NEWLINE}Cycling Road, the atmosphere soured...{SCROLL}At least, that’s what some people{NEWLINE}have been saying.{SCROLL}We’re not doing anything mean to{NEWLINE}anyone, though!{SCROLL}All we’re doing is challenging strong{NEWLINE}Trainers to Pokémon battles, that’s it!{SCROLL}People like you, for example!

strings.zh: 我半夜在外面骑车,{NEWLINE}结果发现了暗之石！{SCROLL}我想你可能会需要它的,{CLEAR}所以就想着要送给你！{SCROLL}你想要的话可以来{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}拿吧！
strings.en: I was out riding in the middle of the{NEWLINE}night, and I found a Dusk Stone!{SCROLL}I figured you might need it,{NEWLINE}so I want to give it to you!{SCROLL}If you want it, come get{NEWLINE}it at {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 难得我想把暗之石送给你,{CLEAR}难道说你不要？{SCROLL}我就在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}随你什么时候来！不对,马上过来！
strings.en: You know, I went through a lot of{NEWLINE}trouble saving you this Dusk Stone,{CLEAR}and you don’t even want it!{SCROLL}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}, so come over{NEWLINE}whenever. No... Come over now!
